data.description: You can wield a quarterstaff as either a two-handed or one-handed weapon.
data.name: Quarterstaff Master

raw_tokens.value: You can wield a quarterstaff as either a two-handed or one-handed weapon.

By employing a number of different stances and techniques, you can wield a quarterstaff as a onehanded weapon. At the start of your turn, you decide whether or not you are going to wield the quarterstaff as a one-handed or two-handed weapon. When you wield it as a one-handed weapon, your other hand is free, and you cannot use the staff as a double weapon. You can take the feat Weapon Specialization in the quarterstaff even if you have no levels in fighter.
